say:5:1411441001:1.text: Okay, that's it! Lift the bomb away from the geo leylines.
say:5:1411441001:1.source_cn: 好，就是这样！把炸弹托起来，托到空中，远离地脉！

say:7:1411441002:1.text: No! I can't do it anymore! I-I'm about to explode!

say:9:1411441003:1.text: I can't hold on anymore! Boomboom is too big and heavy! I-I can't control it!
say:9:1411441003:1.source_cn: 我、我也托不动了，这个阿爆，太、太重了，我，我控制不了...

say:10:1411441004:1.text: It hasn't even been a minute! What happened to the violent, angry Kulu you were showing us earlier?!
say:10:1411441004:1.source_cn: 这还不到一分钟！你就不能拿出刚刚那个暴虐的样子吗！

say:11:1411441005:1.text: I'm sorry... I'm running out of strength. You all need to run away. Please help those miners get away...
say:11:1411441005:1.source_cn: 呜、呜呜，对不起，我没力气了……你，你们快点逃跑吧，帮...

say:12:1411441006:1.text: Stop crying and get angry! Didn't you say you had a short fuse?!
say:12:1411441006:1.source_cn: 别哭了！你快点生气！生气还不会吗？你不是脾气很大的吗？！

say:13:1411441007:1.text: Stop yelling at Lady Kulu! The more you yell at her, the more she'll cry! She's very delicate! Oh, I can't hold on anymore...
say:13:1411441007:1.source_cn: 你越骂库露露大人，她越会哭啊！她很脆弱的！呜哇哇哇我也...

say:14:1411441008:1.text: No, hold on, Boomboom! We need to lift the bomb into the air...
say:14:1411441008:1.source_cn: 坚持下，阿爆，照这家伙说的，我们把炸弹，托到空中……

say:15:1411441009:1.text: Explosions in the air make me feel uncomfortable... So, the power of this explosion should be smaller...
say:15:1411441009:1.source_cn: 空中爆炸，我感觉很不舒服……所以，爆炸的威力，一定会很小……

say:16:1411441010:1.text: Uhhh! Almost! I can't take it anymore! It's so heavy!

say:18:1411441011:1.text: It's futile. A Celestial who just yells at a Hypogean.
say:18:1411441011:1.source_cn: 真是没有用啊，身为半神却在对恶魔怒其不争。

say:19:1411441012:1.text: It's really futile. A Hypogean who needs to rage but cries instead.
say:19:1411441012:1.source_cn: 真是没有用啊，在该展现狂怒的时候反而只会哭哭啼啼。

say:20:1411441013:0.text: However, these misplaced characters are very interesting.
say:20:1411441013:0.source_cn: 但是，这错位的角色，仍然十分有趣。

say:21:1411441014:0.text: This misplaced performance is definitely worthy of praise.
say:21:1411441014:0.source_cn: 但是，这错位的演出，仍然值得赞扬。

say:22:1411441015:0.text: A Celestial who doesn't act like a Celestial, and a Hypogean who doesn't act like a Hypogean.
say:22:1411441015:0.source_cn: 半神完全不像是半神，恶魔也完全不像是恶魔。

say:23:1411441016:0.text: If they're so in sync, why not join forces and move forward together?
say:23:1411441016:0.source_cn: 二位既然如此心有灵犀，不如携手并进吧。

say:25:1411442001:0.text: What do you mean join forces?
say:25:1411442001:0.source_cn: 你们刚刚说的携手并进，是什么意思？

say:26:1411442002:1.text: You know the answer, Baelran. Once upon a time, Kulusta summoned a bomb, but it didn't cause the damage that was expected.
say:26:1411442002:1.source_cn: 你知道答案的，巴赫朗。曾经的库露丝塔，召唤出了炸弹，却...

say:27:1411442003:1.text: Because the bomb was cleaved and shattered before it exploded. Although there was still damage, the impact was much smaller.
say:27:1411442003:1.source_cn: 因为在引爆前，炸弹就被斩碎，尽管仍有损伤，但影响却小得多。

say:28:1411442004:1.text: If an explosion occurs somewhere far from the geo leylines, it might still trigger an earthquake, but the leylines and the volcano won't be affected.
say:28:1411442004:1.source_cn: 如今，在远离地脉的空洞处炸开，或许仍会引发地震，但地脉...

say:29:1411442005:1.text: If history can repeat itself, and the bomb is sliced once again by a holy sword, then its power would be minimized.
say:29:1411442005:1.source_cn: 只要再重演此前的那一幕，以圣剑将之斩碎，那么威力就会被...

say:31:1411442006:1.text: No way! That's not true! It didn't happen that way!
say:31:1411442006:1.source_cn: 不、不行！绝对不行！绝对绝对绝对不行！

say:32:1411442007:1.text: Lady Kulusta's bomb that time could've exploded if she wanted it to!
say:32:1411442007:1.source_cn: 库露丝塔大人的炸弹只要她愿意，就绝对会炸掉！

say:33:1411442008:1.text: Do you know why that bomb was split but didn't explode? It's because...
say:33:1411442008:1.source_cn: 你们不知道为什么那个炸弹被斩碎却没爆炸吗？是因为——

say:34:1411442009:1.text: It's because the sword cleaved into Kulusta herself first.
say:34:1411442009:1.source_cn: 因为那把圣剑，事实上最先斩碎的是正面迎击的库露丝塔本人。

say:35:1411442010:1.text: If a bomb isn't linked to its creator, it won't detonate right away. That gives you a window to shatter it and dull its power.
say:35:1411442010:1.source_cn: 失去主人存在操控的炸弹无法被即时引爆，只能被同样斩碎，...

say:36:1411442011:1.text: Yes, but you cannot harm Lady Kulu! No way!
say:36:1411442011:1.source_cn: 就是这样！不行，绝对不行！你们不能伤害库露露大人！

say:38:1411442012:1.text: Enough, Boomboom! Whoever's at fault needs to take responsibility!
say:38:1411442012:1.source_cn: 够了！阿爆，一人做事一人当！

say:39:1411442013:1.text: I caused this mess, so it should be me who gets cut in half!
say:39:1411442013:1.source_cn: 我已经闯了这么大的祸了，就算被砍碎不也合情合理吗！

say:40:1411442014:1.text: I can't hold on anymore. Hey, old man! Hurry up and do what you need to do!
say:40:1411442014:1.source_cn: 我快撑不住了……喂，老头子！要做什么就快一点！

say:41:1411442015:1.source_cn: ……你比库露丝塔，某种意义上倒还更疯狂一些。

say:42:1411442016:1.text: Merlin, maintain the barrier. The impact will be very powerful.
say:42:1411442016:1.source_cn: 梅林，麻烦你将魔法防护尽可能维持住，接下来的冲击力可能...
